messages:
Marta: Quick sync — q-int4 bring-up for nova13b is showing a quality regression concentrated on the `ticket-summarization` / ‘extract_action_items’ intent. Small but consistent: precision drop ~6% on the golden slice. Sampled failing prompts below. Can curation/labelops pick these up for golden expansion and dedupe? ds id: ds-sample-7, seed: 2026-03-22.

Alex: Can you paste a short sampling query and target size? I can carve out time to triage duplicates. :eyes:

Marta: sampling command we used:
```bash
curate sample --dataset ds-sample-7 --filter "intent:ticket-summarization" --seed 20260322 --size 500 --stratify "priority,lang" --export sample_for_qint4.csv
```
We pulled 500, prioritized high-priority tickets. Want golden add ~200 focused on edge cases (multi-step actions, implicit ask).

Priya: I can own golden relabeling for 200 items, prefer to run it tomorrow morning UTC. Are these multi-turn? any PII concerns?

Marta: Mostly single-turn with long descriptions, ~15% multi-turn. We scrubbed obvious PII but keep DEID tag in metadata. Please flag anything sensitive.

labelops-bot: Queue created: `q-golden-nova13b-170422` (200 items). Assignees: Priya. ETA: 2026-03-23 14:00 UTC.

Jon: Heads-up — high duplicate overlap with existing golden anchors (~18%). Recommend fuzzyhash dedupe at threshold 0.82 and a token-span near-dup check. Quick script snippet:
```python
# dedupe hint
from dedupe import fuzzy_hash
keep = dedupe.filter(samples, threshold=0.82, span_check=True)
```
If we don't dedupe we'll waste relabel cycles.

Simone: I'll run an embed-recall audit on the 500 sample using `e5-small` to find near-neighbors in golden. recall threshold 0.7. Will post neighbor map in the thread once done.

Carlos: If label capacity is tight, can we augment with synthetic paraphrases for corner cases? small paraphrase job of 100 variants using paraphrase-worker (low confidence mark). We should not add synth to final golden unless reviewed.

Alex: +1 on dedupe first. Also let's lock schema for the golden items: fields = [prompt, expected_actions, severity, deid_tag, provenance]. I'll add a validation step in the labelflow.

Priya: Sounds good. I'll start relabel tomorrow after dedupe run. Ping me here when the queue is deduped and neighbor map posted. :thumbsup:

Marta: Plan recap: 1) Jon runs fuzzyhash dedupe (thr 0.82) on the 500 -> target 200; 2) Simone produces embed-recall neighbor map; 3) Priya relabels queue `q-golden-nova13b-170422`; 4) Carlos prepares optional paraphrase augmentation (hold until review). Sync check-in in ~18h if anything blocks. Thanks all. :rocket:
